task: Inspect live generic index and source-free member requirement relations during H1 closure
observation: Before the H1 fix, moss inspect repeated one generic values[0] Index requirement five times and omitted its Int index argument; the query hid a required type relation. A truly absent generic method reported TYPE_MISMATCH with provider source but METHOD_NOT_FOUND after importing its .mossi, despite equivalent requirements.
impact: The query could not establish one complete index requirement, and source-backed/source-free diagnostics diverged for an absent generic member.

resolution.summary: Deduplicated the Index constraint, retained its index argument and result relation, projected structured requirement facts, and made absent generic members METHOD_NOT_FOUND in both modes while existing members with incompatible arguments remain TYPE_MISMATCH. Original provider provenance remains attached.

task: Close static callable requirements and effects without publishing an unsound source-free open summary
observation: A generic callback call initially had no ordered argument/result relation in its typed requirement. Its open effect summary correctly remained unresolved, but an exported ABI-v10 provider still emitted a legacy generic interface that a source-free consumer could check and build after the provider source was removed. Concrete specialization also retained callable:name instead of the exact callable ID during the effect rewalk, so both pure and raising callbacks appeared unresolved.
impact: The inspect API could not prove the callback relation, concrete effects were not distinguishable, and a source-free export bypassed the required checked open-summary effect contract.

resolution.summary: Retained typed callback argument/result relations in an inspect-only table, resolved exact callable IDs while rechecking concrete effects, kept the generic summary unpublished on unresolved effects, and added staged-v10 export/import fail-closed diagnostics for source-free callback generics.
